content: वनस्पतिः [वनस्य पतिः नि˚ सुट्] .²1 A large forest tree, especially one that bears fruit apparently without any blossoms; अपुष्पाः फलवन्तो ये ते वनस्पतयः स्मृताः <ls>Ms. 1. 47</ls>. .²2 A tree in general; तमाशु विघ्नं तपसस्तपस्वी वनस्पतिं वज्र इवावभज्य <ls>Ku. 3. 74</ls>. .²3 The Soma plant. .²4 A stem, trunk. .²5 A beam; pole, post. .²6 A sacrificial post. .²7 An offering to {%Vanaspati%}. .²8 A wooden amulet. .²9 A scaffold. .²10 An ascetic.
